title: Nylas notification envelope
description: All Nylas webhook notifications use the [CloudEvents](https://cloudevents.io/) envelope format. The envelope fields are the same for every notification type — the `data.object` structure varies by trigger.

type.description: The notification trigger name (e.g. `grant.expired`, `message.created`). Matches the trigger you subscribed to when creating the webhook.

source.description: Origin of the event, generally in `/<provider>/<product>/<sync_type>` format. Common values include `/google/emails/realtime`, `/google/emails/historic`, `/google/emails/incremental`, `/microsoft/emails/realtime`, `/google/events/incremental`, `/google/contacts/incremental`, `/nylas/system` (grants), `/nylas/send` (message send), `/nylas/passthru` (scheduler), `/nylas/notetaker` (notetaker), and `/com/nylas/tracking` (message tracking).

id.description: Unique notification ID. Use this for deduplication — Nylas guarantees at-least-once delivery, so you may receive the same notification more than once.

time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the event occurred.

webhook_delivery_attempt.description: Which delivery attempt this is. `1` on the first try, up to `3` if previous attempts failed.

object.description: The affected resource. Structure varies by trigger type — see individual schemas below.
